//Maxio: Recurring-subscription billing (Maxio Advanced Billing). Declared here so the required keys
are discoverable; the values are intentionally blank and must never be committed. Supply them
with user-secrets in development -- dotnet user-secrets set "Maxio:ApiKey" <key> -- or with
Maxio__ApiKey / Maxio__Subdomain / Maxio__ProductFamilyHandle environment variables elsewhere.
BaseUrl is an optional override used verbatim in place of https://{Subdomain}.chargify.com.
